irregularities.what: The session prompt contains two incompatible 'current high score' claims: 0.3195 (DARD, public #1) and 0.4413 ('current competition leaderboard GEMSDOE high score'). The digits 0.4413 coincide EXACTLY with GEMSDOE32 IR-33-LM-01, where 0.4413 was a drift-model artifact for a pruned variant (1.35x the then-leader, refuted by the live record) — not a leaderboard row. Either (a) a team genuinely reached 0.4413 (extraordinary: +38% over 0.3195), or (b) the prompt line misquotes the instrument artifact as a leaderboard score. Sandbox egress blocks drivendata.org, so this repo verified NEITHER. Lane-82 work targets beating the verified group-best chain (0.2778) and is unaffected by this ambiguity, but any 'we are #N on the board' claim must wait for a dated leaderboard snapshot. UPDATE 2026-10-21 merge: a sibling session in this repo reports reading the live leaderboard on 2026-10-21 with the earlier/higher figure (0.4413) on top (their IR-82-04). Adopted as second-source confirmation; 0.3195 treated as stale. The 0.4413-vs-LM-artifact digit coincidence remains unexplained.

No organizer receipt links ANY group file's bytes to ANY leaderboard row (same finding as GEMSDOE32 IR-32-SCORE-01). All score attributions (0.2600/0.2708/0.2778 chain, 0.3195 DARD) are OWNER-REPORTED. The live-anchored inversion (T=5069, K~13300) is CONDITIONAL on the chain's attribution being correct. The pixel-exact prune chain (D2.8 -> R1 -> B2) is byte-verified; the SCORES attached to it are not.

Gate v1.0 compared candidate SGMC-FAR quadrants against hand-copied SGMC-RAW quadrant constants (wrong instrument), falsely failing R2 (1/4 instead of 4/4). Fixed by evaluating the base mask in-process. Regression coverage: tests/test_gate.py pins in-process base quadrants to the receipt.

SGMC-proxy truth covers only PART of the live hidden truth and rewards scarp-chasing (SGMC faults are surface-expressed by construction): a fresh h82_1 emission scores SGMC-FAR 0.1403 yet CAT-HIDDEN 0.0030 (~random). SGMC-FAR is therefore licensed ONLY for flank surgery on a fixed carrier + screened additions — never for wholesale emission replacement. Lane H82-3 retains 23,000 carrier dots (including all 1,611 near-tip 2<d2c<3 px dots) so CAT-HIDDEN also improves (+0.000141).

The 19-band training_features.tif was never fetched (418 MB; only available login-walled or as owner-mirror parts). Lane 82 uses ONLY the sha256-pinned external u8 stacks + GDR tables + catalogue grids. Any detector needing the official 19 bands (e.g. MT conductivity, InSAR) is out of scope for this lane.

Track dispute: canonical track (IR-82-12) rejects mirror+private-tooling artifacts for submission; lane H82-3 (verified mirrors + exact-verified code + strict 8-rule v2.0 machine gate + honest labels) holds its file submittable. Both preserved; owner picks.

Historical H82-2 (37,091 dots) retained 35,591/37,654 carrier dots from H33-2-B2, causing full-mask 3px overlap 0.9611 > 0.70 and Spearman rho 0.9522 > 0.90 (violating Rule 1; stopped in PR #11). Gate v2.0 adds hard rule R6b_full_mask_independence (zero carrier exemption). Lane H82-3 (35,000 dots: 23,000 corroborated carrier dots + 12,000 novel dots >3px from all 6 registry rasters) passes both R6a (max surface rho 0.0450 <= 0.90, added 3px overlap 0.0000 <= 0.70) and R6b (max full-mask rho 0.6325 <= 0.90, max full-mask 3px overlap 0.6571 <= 0.70) against D2.8, R1-SOLO, H33-2-B2, H36-rung30, H19-5, and historical H82-2.

USGS 3DEP 1m LiDAR covers only 75.37% of the competition footprint (and only 54.2% of NE quadrant; 45.8% has valid_lidar == 0). Historical H82-2 zero-filled missing LiDAR, causing 52.1% (1,075/2,063) of its removed dots to be pruned simply because they fell in valid_lidar == 0 pixels. Fixed in Lane H82-3 by adding H82-2.6 (GeoDAWN TMI_up150 Laplace-tilt/horizontal-gradient ridges, 99.94% footprint coverage) and stratum-wise quantile normalisation (coverage_aware_corroboration()).

Historical H82-2 filtered Exp1/Exp2 removals by midcred == 0 (evaluated against ctx.sgmc_mid), using holdout proxy truth inside dot selection and inflating SGMC-FAR/MID/RAW margins while dropping CAT-HIDDEN (-0.000018). Fixed in Lane H82-3: Exp1/Exp2/Exp3 dot selection is 100% label-free and proxy-free, improving all four holdouts including CAT-HIDDEN (+0.000141).

scripts/fetch_data.sh originally used 'gh api -q .content | base64 -d', which writes 0 bytes for GitHub files >1 MB, and '[ -f $local ]' treated 0-byte files as present. Fixed to use '[ -s $local ]' and 'gh api -H Accept:application/vnd.github.raw'.
